instruction: Cinematic still of a medium shot showing three men in a stylized dance pose inside a large hall. In the center, the blonde man in the leather jacket (R1) tilts his head back dynamically, chest bare. On the left, the man in the white t-shirt and harness (R3) holds his arms framed around his head, looking forward. On the right, the man in the black mesh crop top (R2) poses with hands framing his face, gazing intensely at the camera. They stand close together in a staggered dance formation, performing a synchronized routine. Cool blue and purple stage lighting bathes the dancers, creating a moody atmosphere.
elements: R1 is the central dancer tilting his head back dynamically
R2 is the dancer framing his face with his hands and gazing intensely at the camera
